meta.title: ABLE Hakuba GORYU
meta.description: Northern Alps powder and a 24-hour base center—Hakuba from Nagano Station.

transit.title:
Shinkansen to
Hakuba.
transit.lead: About one hour by express bus from Hokuriku Shinkansen Nagano Station, or roughly 60 minutes by car from Azumino IC—an all-around Hakuba resort within reach of a Tokyo day trip.
transit.imgAlt: Winter scenery from a Shinkansen window—journey from Nagano toward Hakuba

primary.title: Alps-daira powder
primary.lead: Above 1,500 m on Alps-daira, Northern Alps views meet premium powder. The Goryu Telecabin reaches the summit in about eight minutes—linked with Hakuba47 for 24 courses and up to 5,000 m of skiing in a day.
primary.imgAlt: Skier on powder with Northern Alps panorama from Alps-daira

secondary.title: 24-hour Escal Plaza
secondary.lead: Escal Plaza runs 24 hours in winter—day-use onsen Ryujin no Yu, restaurants, rentals, and nap rooms in Hakuba's largest base hub.

onsen.title:
After skiing,
Ryujin no Yu.
onsen.lead: Ryujin no Yu hot spring connects directly to Escal Plaza—recover after skiing without leaving the resort.
onsen.whisper: Village restaurants and baths like Juro no Yu also anchor a wider Hakuba loop.
onsen.imgAlt: Snow-view bath at Hakuba Himekawa Onsen Ryujin no Yu

hutte.title: Soba-dokoro Yamato
hutte.lead: Famous walnut-topped soba in Hakuba—warm hand-cut noodles after skiing (check each shop).

tabikura.title: Sakana Saibo Yukimaru
tabikura.lead: Izakaya with kotatsu seating—local food and sake for a village dinner after the hill (official hours first).

nearbyFood.pairingLead: Morning bus from Nagano → warm up at Toomi → Alps-daira powder → Hakuba47 → Ryujin no Yu → dinner at Yukimaru.

powder.title: Alps-daira powder
powder.body: 16 courses, 926 m vertical. Grand Prix and Technical runs serve ungroomed powder; Iimori is family-friendly—link to Hakuba47 for 24 courses in one day.

drive.title: From Nagano Station
drive.body: Express bus about one hour from Hokuriku Shinkansen Nagano Station. Rent a car at Nagano Station for village loops via Azumino IC—or walk/shuttle from Kamishiro Station on the Oito Line.

soba.title: Sustainable resort
soba.body: 100% renewable energy, multilingual QRSKI concierge, and a 24-hour Escal Plaza—GORYU pairs environmental care with resort-scale convenience.

access.note: Express bus ~1 hr from Nagano Station · ~60 min by car from Azumino IC · Kamishiro Station walk/shuttle
